title: GPT-6.2 Astra driving Codex scores 97% on RoboDojo-RC Tier 1 across 120 real robot trials; Robocurve retires the benchmark
headline: Coding agent harness drives real robots at 97%
lede: You can use a coding-agent harness as a robot controller: GPT-6.2 Astra through Codex hit 97% on 120 real trials, and all 360 runs with transcripts and videos are public.

effects.effect: Harness quality shown to swing results by 31 points
Benchmark retired, so harder robot tests are needed
General coding agents become viable robot controllers

with.title: FastRUA makes robot-use agents about three times faster

possibilities.connection: Robocurve's coding-agent harness reached 97% on real trials but dedicated robot models stay 4x faster, and FastRUA attacks exactly that latency by overlapping planning with motion so robots move 84% of the time instead of 24%.
